name: Get Rayvn file
info:
Fetches a single file from a publicly-accessible signed Rayvn URL.
Mirrors Get Wasos file.

### Input
- msg.payload — synthetic file object with .url (full signed URL), .name, .type, .size
- msg.metadata — standard metadata
- msg._dl — download context (message_id, connection_name)
- msg.parts — join parts for reassembly

### Logic
1. Build download request — sets msg.url, no auth header required.
2. GET file — HTTP request, returns binary buffer.
3. Capture response headers — resolves actual Content-Type and filename from
   response headers and writes into _file_meta before leaving this subflow.

### Output
- msg.payload — binary Buffer
- msg.statusCode — HTTP status
- msg._file_meta — { url, name, type, size } resolved from response headers
- msg.parts — preserved for join node
- msg._dl — preserved for merge node
